chapter_note: Chapter has a clear bipartite structure: (1) Love as bond of the Greatness — substrate cosmological teaching about the Father called 'Love' [4-10], extended editorially to the holy Church [11-23] via the bridge ⲁⲛ ('moreover') with citation of John 15:13; (2) Hatred as the first death from the land of Darkness — substrate teaching [25-29, 33-34, 36-38] interleaved with 'today' application material [30-32, 35]. The ecclesial extension is a textbook editorial seam: the Father-Love mapping is closed at [10] ('with his members'), then the bridge phrase reapplies the Love-correspondence to ⲧⲉⲕⲕⲗⲏⲥⲓⲁ ⲉⲧⲟⲩⲁⲃⲉ. Heavy damage (69.2%) makes some boundaries uncertain.
